data.title: Moor Creek Beach
data.about:
Nestled in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour, Moor at Creek Beach offers unrivaled access to major roads and attractions. Choose from a wide selection of stunning 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Each home at Moor Creek Beach is meticulously designed to maximize space and natural light, creating a haven of contemporary, understated luxury. The interiors blend sophisticated yet simplistic design aesthetics with tasteful architectural touches.

This prime location combines the charm of one of Dubai’s most treasured historical sites with the convenience of modern urban living. Enjoy the serene waterfront, lush landscapes, and the vibrant energy of a thriving community at Moor in Dubai Creek Harbour.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Nestled at the heart of a family-focused community in Dubai Creek Harbour, Moor at Creek Beach offers breathtaking surroundings and picturesque views.
  • Convenient Access: Just 10 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai and 15 minutes from Dubai International Airport, making commuting easy and convenient.
  • Vibrant Lifestyle: Enjoy a vibrant array of shopping, dining, and family-friendly leisure experiences right on your doorstep.
  • World-Class Amenities: Benefit from a wide array of world-class amenities, including top-notch facilities designed for your comfort and convenience.
  • Bustling Inner-Plaza: The development features a bustling inner-plaza, providing a lively and engaging community atmosphere.
  • Elegant Apartments: Moor at Creek Beach offers elegantly designed apartments with sophisticated flair, combining chic yet simplistic design aesthetics with tasteful architectural touches.
  • Exquisite Living Spaces: Experience exquisite living spaces that maximize natural light and space, creating a serene and luxurious ambiance.
  • Leisure and Retail Proximity: Just footsteps away from a world of dining, retail, and leisure options, ensuring you have everything you need within easy reach.
  • Family-Focused Environment: The community is designed with families in mind, offering a safe and engaging environment for all ages.
  • Serene Surroundings: Enjoy the serene waterfront and lush landscapes, providing a tranquil escape from the bustling city life.
  • Modern Urban Living: Combines the charm of one of Dubai’s most treasured historical sites with the convenience of modern urban living.

location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Situated in the dynamic Dubai Creek Harbour, Emaar Moor embodies a bold and innovative vision for Dubai, setting new standards in architecture and lifestyle. This notable waterfront area is home to Creek Beach, Dubai’s first urban beach. Nestled along the historic Dubai Creek, Creek Beach offers the ultimate family-friendly retreat with 700 meters of pristine white sands, an infinity pool, and breathtaking sunset views. Experience a reborn paradise in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour at Emaar Moor.

05 Minutes -from Ras al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary
10 Minutes - from Downtown Dubai
15 Minutes - from Dubai Int’l Airport
35 Minutes - from Al Maktoum Int’l Airport
